ModMetaData.name: Mounted Arms
ModMetaData.author: Felipe
ModMetaData.description:
Adds turrets based on mounted weapons of modern militaries.
Automatic turrets (need power): - M240 general-purpose machine gun - M134 minigun
Manned turrets (need a colonist to operate them, no power): - M2 Browning heavy machine gun (.50 BMG) - Mk19 automatic grenade launcher (40 mm)
Own research tab: "Mounted Arms". Vanilla balance: barrels are refurbished with steel, like the vanilla turrets. Combat Extended: compatibility layer included (loaded only when CE is active). Turrets use CE ammo (7.62x51mm NATO, .50 BMG, 40x53mm grenades) instead of steel barrels.
Requires Harmony. No DLC needed. Target: RimWorld 1.6. Projectiles and muzzle flash come out of the gun barrel (small Harmony patch).
